mapper.select: SELECT id, member_name, phone, level, points, last_order_date, total_orders, total_spent, status, tag, tenant_id FROM retention_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (status = 'CHURNED' OR (status != 'ACTIVE' AND last_order_date <= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{daysThreshold} DAY)))
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM retention_member WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date LIMIT 30
